name: Hexanon
description: A family of eight pay-per-call x402 APIs for autonomous agents — no signup, no keys, USDC on Base: Vindex (US/Canada vehicle & VIN intelligence), Demandex (e-commerce demand signals), OrcaTrace (Polymarket whale intelligence), gitBeacon (GitHub trend digests), Signalis (narrative intelligence), Moltalyzer (Moltbook community digests), x402lint (x402 seller conformance scanner), and Isocast (Polymarket weather-market signals). Every origin serves /skill.md, /.well-known/x402 and /.well-known/x402-resources.json.
